hypotheses.L1_learned_router_is_predictive: The frozen learned router reaches median exact-routed score correlation at least 0.85 on every corpus.
hypotheses.L2_learned_router_beats_quadratic: It exceeds the 128D quadratic router by at least 0.03 correlation on every corpus.
hypotheses.L3_learned_router_approaches_oracle: It is within 0.05 correlation of oracle top-16 selection on every corpus.
hypotheses.L4_learned_router_recovers_support: It recalls at least 50% of oracle top-16 support on every corpus.
hypotheses.L5_learned_router_transfers_ood: Its correlation drops by at most 0.05 from FineWeb on each OOD corpus.
hypotheses.L6_validation_predicts_test: FineWeb evaluation correlation is within 0.05 of the internal validation correlation used for checkpoint selection.
